practical_scenarios.title: WordPress update breaks checkout
practical_scenarios.situation: A plugin update produces fatal errors on checkout immediately after deployment.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Freeze further changes, enable the documented maintenance response, inspect logs and health, roll back the plugin or restore the tested artifact, verify orders and data integrity, then reproduce on staging and add compatibility tests before retrying.

practical_scenarios.title: Editors have excessive publishing access
practical_scenarios.situation: Several content editors can install plugins and edit global templates although their job is only to draft articles.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Inventory current capabilities, remove unnecessary administrator access, create an editorial role, add review and emergency escalation, test direct actions and document periodic access review.

practical_scenarios.title: Traffic falls after CMS migration
practical_scenarios.situation: Organic traffic drops after launch and many old URLs return 404 or point to generic pages.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Compare old and new URL inventories, restore highest-value redirects, fix canonical and internal links, submit clean sitemaps, monitor server logs and Search Console, and avoid broad redirect patterns that hide mapping errors.

practical_scenarios.title: JavaScript pages are not indexed
practical_scenarios.situation: A catalog SPA works for users but rendered inspection shows empty or incomplete product content.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Ensure every item has a stable URL and crawlable link, render essential content and metadata in initial or server-generated HTML where feasible, remove blocked resources and validate the search-rendered output.

practical_scenarios.title: Campaign hero damages LCP
practical_scenarios.situation: Marketing adds a large autoplay hero and conversion pages become slow on mobile.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Measure field and lab impact, replace or compress the asset, prioritize the actual LCP resource, avoid lazy loading it, reduce third-party work and agree a performance budget and fallback with marketing.

practical_scenarios.title: Analytics disappears after consent launch
practical_scenarios.situation: Reported traffic falls sharply after a new consent manager is deployed, but business activity appears stable.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Validate consent defaults and transitions, inspect tag and network behavior by choice, compare expected eligible traffic, check filters and processing delay, fix implementation without bypassing user choices and annotate the reporting break.

practical_scenarios.title: Stored XSS through rich text
practical_scenarios.situation: An editor pastes unsafe HTML into a rich-text field and it executes for other users.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Disable or restrict unsafe input immediately, identify affected content and sessions, sanitize with an allow-list, escape output by context, review editor privilege and add regression tests plus CSP defense in depth.

practical_scenarios.title: CDN caches private dashboard
practical_scenarios.situation: Authenticated account data is occasionally shown to the wrong user after a cache-rule change.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Bypass and purge the affected cache, verify origin authorization, mark personalized responses private or no-store, correct cache keys and cookies, review logs for exposure and follow the privacy incident process.

practical_scenarios.title: Headless preview shows stale content
practical_scenarios.situation: Editors approve changes in preview but the published site continues showing an older version.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Trace draft versus delivery endpoints, webhook events, build or revalidation status and CDN keys; expose publish status to editors, retry failed events and invalidate only affected routes.

practical_scenarios.title: Webhook storm triggers excessive builds
practical_scenarios.situation: Bulk editing sends thousands of webhook events and deployment queues grow for hours.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Acknowledge quickly, filter irrelevant events, deduplicate by entity and version, debounce or batch affected routes, cap concurrency and provide replay from a durable queue.

practical_scenarios.title: Custom modal fails keyboard testing
practical_scenarios.situation: A modal traps some keyboard users, loses focus after closing and has no announced title.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Replace it with a tested native or APG-aligned pattern, set an accessible name, move focus on open, contain logical navigation, support Escape where appropriate and restore focus to the invoker.

practical_scenarios.title: Multilingual fallback mixes languages
practical_scenarios.situation: A localized page displays translated headings with default-language body fields and broken right-to-left layout.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Define required versus optional localized fields and fallback policy, block incomplete high-risk publishing, set correct language and direction metadata, test templates with expansion and give editors completeness visibility.

practical_scenarios.title: Domain fails after go-live
practical_scenarios.situation: After changing DNS and proxy settings, some users see certificate errors while others reach the old site.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Check authoritative nameservers and record answers from multiple resolvers, validate proxy mode and origin TLS, compare TTL and certificate hostnames, roll back one layer if needed and communicate propagation expectations.

practical_scenarios.title: Deployment succeeds but site is broken
practical_scenarios.situation: The pipeline is green, yet production serves missing assets and API requests fail.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Treat deployment completion separately from service health, run post-deploy smoke checks, inspect base paths, environment variables and CORS, roll back the artifact if user impact is material, then add the failed checks to the gate.

practical_scenarios.title: CMS listing overloads the database
practical_scenarios.situation: A popular Drupal listing with filters causes timeouts during peak traffic.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Capture slow queries and cache behavior, simplify joins and exposed filters, add appropriate indexes or pagination, verify access and cache contexts, precompute where justified and monitor under representative load.

practical_scenarios.title: Headless proposal ignores author needs
practical_scenarios.situation: Engineering proposes replacing a working CMS with a headless stack, but preview, page composition and support ownership are undefined.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Run a capability and total-cost assessment, prototype authoring and preview, identify integration and on-call ownership, compare incremental improvement and proceed only when channel or platform benefits justify permanent complexity.

practical_scenarios.title: Content model change breaks applications
practical_scenarios.situation: A field is renamed in the CMS and several websites fail because generated clients expect the old schema.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Restore compatibility or alias the field, inventory consumers, use additive model changes, version migration scripts and contracts, deprecate with telemetry and remove only after every consumer has migrated.

practical_scenarios.title: Critical plugin vulnerability disclosed
practical_scenarios.situation: A widely used plugin has an actively exploited vulnerability and a patch is available, but normal release testing takes several days.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Assess exposure and compensating controls, back up, patch or disable rapidly through an emergency path, test critical journeys, monitor indicators, rotate secrets if needed and complete retrospective and inventory cleanup.
